name: Goi bon bon
summary: Gỏi bồn bồn is a bồn bồn salad, served at dinner along the Hậu on a Can Tho sampler with grilled duck skewers, shrimp in sugar cane, beef in betel leaf, and pork skewers.
origin: Can Tho dinner tables along the Hậu.
howToEat: At a table, at dinner, as part of the sampler.
seoTitle: Goi bon bon in Can Tho
seoDescription: Bồn bồn salad from the Can Tho dinner sampler along the Hậu.
